text: Open call for PhD candidates: we support applications to the FPU and “la Caixa” INPhINIT fellowships — see [join us](/join/).

Carlos gives the lecture “Advanced Quantum Communications” at the DPG Physics School on Applied Photonics in Bad Honnef — from photon detection to QKD with true single-photon sources. A fantastic week with a brilliant, curious audience!
Pablo Pérez Casares defends his master thesis on the dipole orientation of quantum emitters in hBN with a 9.2/10. Congratulations, Pablo!
Publication from Andrea's results: [“Spin-polarized lasing in a photonic lattice”](https://opg.optica.org/ome/fulltext.cfm?uri=ome-16-8-2769), Opt. Mater. Express.
Samuel and Izan win two of the INC Research Awards for Physics Students 2026. Congrats!
The first edition of the elective course “Quantum Information Technologies” is finished.

We launch the special issue [Engineering scalable quantum photonic systems](https://www.frontiersin.org/research-topics/79664/engineering-scalable-quantum-photonic-systems) in Frontiers in Physics, with Stefano Azzini (lead), Niccolò Bigagli, Thibault Chervy and Andrew Young.
We celebrate the [QLITES26 workshop](https://www.qlites2026.com) in Oviedo.
We close the year with Juan's first publication — [link to the paper](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsphotonics.5c02227). Congratulations!
New preprint with the group of Zhiliang Yuan: [a Bell test with vacuum–one-photon states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15413).
An amazing week at the [XXI INC Summer School on Quantum Photonic Technologies](https://www.inc.uam.es/summer-school-2025/).
Andrea wins the Best Poster Prize at the [Spanish Conference on Nanophotonics](https://benasque.org/2025cen/). 🏆
Alejandro aces his Bachelor thesis with Matrícula de Honor.
We welcome Christos Paspalides, the new FPI-IFIMAC PhD student working on interlayer excitons in 2D materials.
We announce the INC Summer School on quantum photonic technologies — [pre-register here](https://eventos.uam.es/134138/detail/pre-registration-xxxi-international-summer-school-nicolas-cabrera.html).
On 14 April, follow the Return of the QuanTour Source [online](https://www.youtube.com/live/j-CZPRyPzEM).
Sang Kyu Kim (TUM) visits us again for a month.

INC Young Researchers Meeting in [La Cristalera](https://fuam.es/la-cristalera/) (Miraflores de la Sierra), with three posters: [Juan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/163Et9TXn4GjaFz1Vsg2m1DSkcQWdHflp/view?usp=share_link), [Andrea](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1540fBFNcnc_ftV4ck4vNRkSx1s5ctj98/view?usp=share_link) and [Fito](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HNlG7XlmIt6dPLvOCLbf4x7ZLFLeR_KF/view?usp=share_link).

Two works published in Optica Quantum, with the groups of [P. Senellart (CNRS)](https://opg.optica.org/opticaq/abstract.cfm?doi=10.1364/OPTICAQ.527420) and [T. Heindel (TU Berlin)](https://opg.optica.org/opticaq/abstract.cfm?doi=10.1364/OPTICAQ.538134).
Kick-off meeting of the QuantERA project COMPHORT.
We offer an FPI PhD position within the newly funded national project on biphotonic sources — see [join us](/join/).
Juan Vidal starts his PhD within the QuantERA consortium. Welcome!
Two-week stay at [MajuLab-CQT](https://www.quantumlah.org/people/MajuLab) in the lab of Maxime Richard, on resonantly driven exciton-polaritons.
Carlos receives the [UAM Young Researchers Prize](https://www.uam.es/uam/investigacion/premios-jovenes-investigadores) in Experimental Sciences.

The QuanTour in the [UAM news](https://www.uam.es/uam/investigacion/cultura-cientifica/articulos/emision-fotones-quantour), and interviews on [Madrid Norte 24 Horas](https://www.madridnorte24horas.com/podcast/universidad-autonoma-de-madrid/una-antorcha-cuantica-recorrera-europa-con-parada-en-la-uam-para-acercarnos-al-futuro/) and [Hoy por hoy (SER)](https://cadenaser.com/audio/1715079189050/) (in Spanish).
Attending the BQIT24 conference in Bristol.

Our review [“Solid-State Single-Photon Sources: Recent Advances for Novel Quantum Materials”](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/adfm.202315936) is published in Advanced Functional Materials.

Seminar in the [QMP Morning Coffee Seminar series](https://qmpseminars.com/eventos/generation-of-superposition-and-entanglement-in-the-photon-number-basis-with-solid-state-quantum-devices/), Universitat de València.
Sang Kyu Kim (group of Prof. K. Müller, TUM) visits us for a month.
Preprint with Pascale Senellart's group and Quandela: vacuum–one-photon superpositions in the delayed HOM peaks — [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01187).
Our project COMPHORT is [approved for funding](https://quantera.eu/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/QuantERAII_Call_2023_Funded_Projects.pdf) in the QuantERA 2023 call.
Review preprint on emergent solid-state single-photon sources — [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09280).

The [Polaritonics feature issue](https://opg.optica.org/ome/virtual_issue.cfm?vid=565) of Optical Materials Express is out (G. Grosso, B. Pietka, D. Ballarini, A. Fainstein and C. Antón-Solanas, eds.).

Diego presents his poster on an actively phase-stabilised Mach-Zehnder for HOM interference at the [INC Young Researchers Meeting 2023](https://www.inc.uam.es/inc-young-researchers-meeting-2023-registration-senior-staff/).
Evaluating candidates for the [Quantum Grenoble Doctoral Programme](https://www.phdquantumgrenoble.com).
Published in [Optics Letters](https://opg.optica.org/abstract.cfm?URI=ol-48-23-6332): multipartite entanglement in the photon-number basis.
Published in [PRL](https://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/PhysRevLett.131.206901): second-order coherence of polariton lasers in an atomically thin crystal.

Seminar by [Dr. Tobias Huber](https://www.physik.uni-wuerzburg.de/tep/team/professors-and-group-leaders/dr-tobias-huber-loyola/) (Würzburg) on quantum-dot photon sources for photonic quantum computing.
Published in [Nano Letters](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.nanolett.3c02584): a monolayer single-photon source in a helium-free open cavity with 65% brightness.
Diego receives the [INC 2023 Award](https://www.inc.uam.es/research-awards-physics-students-2023/).
Carlos receives a [Leonardo Grant](https://www.redleonardo.es/beneficiario/carlos-anton-solanas/) from the BBVA Foundation.

Project ULTRA-BRIGHT funded by the [Fundación Ramón Areces](https://www.fundacionareces.es/fundacionareces/es/becas-y-ayudas/proyectos-de-investigacion/listado-de-proyectos/fuentes-ultrabrillantes-de-fotones-en-cavidades-abiertas-ultra-bright.html?filtroActivo=A&filtroIdentificador=4920).
